Name: Immersive Music__Custom JukeBox Update
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[quote][b][i][color=#ffffff]Sử dụng[/color] [color=#ff0000]Google [/color][color=#ffff00]Translate[/color] [color=#efefef]để dịch nội dung nha![/color][/i][/b][/quote][size=5][color=#c27ba0][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i]🎵 Immersive Music — Complete Edition [/i][/b][/font][/color][/size]
[b][color=#ff7700][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]An Intelligent Music System — Bringing Every Moment in Stardew Valley to Life![/font][/size][/color][/b]
Have you ever felt that the background music in [b][color=#ff7700]Stardew Valley[/color][/b] has become too familiar after hundreds of hours of gameplay? Do you want music to adapt naturally to the environment, suit different activities, and avoid constantly replaying the same familiar tracks?
[b][color=#d5a6bd][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Immersive Music — Complete Edition[/i][/font][/color][/b] was created to offer a different kind of music experience.
This is more than just a regular background music replacement mod. Immersive Music features an intelligent, context-aware music system that identifies suitable music groups and manages playback based on the environment, weather, location, and gameplay activities.
From peaceful mornings on the farm and rainy days by the window to cave explorations and quiet nights, music becomes a natural part of your journey. This approach offers a more flexible and immersive experience than older, more limited music replacement mods.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53735/53735-1792907858-1065452419.png[/img]

[b][color=#d4d4d8]🌐 [/color][color=#1155cc][size=4]Language Support[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8] 🇺🇸 English[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] 🇻🇳 Vietnamese[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] 🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese (简体中文) [/color]
[quote][center][color=#c27ba0][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]🎼 A LIBRARY OF 43 CUSTOM MUSIC TRACKS [/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][center]
[left]With a total of  [color=#d5a6bd][b][size=5][i][font=Comic Sans MS]43[/font][/i][/size][i][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]custom music tracks![/size][/font][/i][/b][/color]
[b][color=#d5a6bd]Complete Edition[/color][/b] offers a variety of musical options for supported environments and gameplay situations.
The music groups include:
[list]
[*]🌱 [b][color=#6aa84f]Seasonal Outdoor Music:[/color][/b] Dedicated tracks for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.[/*]
[*]🏖️ [b][color=#ffe599]Beach Music:[/color][/b] A dedicated musical atmosphere for the Beach.[/*]
[*]🌧️ [b][color=#6d9eeb]Rain Music:[/color][/b] Custom music for rainy and stormy weather.[/*]
[*]🎣 [b][color=#00ffff]Fishing Music:[/color][/b] Dedicated music for the fishing minigame, with appropriate playback priority.[/*]
[*]⛏️ [b][color=#b45f06]Cave Music:[/color][/b] A distinct atmosphere for supported cave locations.[/*]
[*]🏠[color=#ff7700] [b]Indoor Music:[/b][/color] Custom music options for supported indoor environments.[/*]
[*]🌙 [b][color=#ffff00]Night Music:[/color][/b] Three new tracks that bring a different atmosphere to nighttime.[/*]
[*]🌌 [b][color=#9900ff]Sleep Summary:[/color][/b] A dedicated track for the end-of-day summary screen.[/*]
[/list]The music priority system helps determine the appropriate music group when multiple conditions occur simultaneously. You can also customize supported features to better suit [b][color=#93c47d][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]your playstyle![/i][/font][/size][/color][/b].[/left]
[/center]
[quote][center][i][b][color=#ffd966][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]✨ WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT? [/font][/size][/color][/b][/i][/center]
[/quote][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🧠 [b][color=#ff00ff]An Intelligent Environment-Based Music System![/color][/b][/font][/size]
[color=#c27ba0][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i]Immersive Music[/i][/b][/font][/color] does not rely entirely on a fixed list of predefined map names. Instead, it uses environmental information and in-game context to determine the appropriate music group.
This approach allows the mod to work across a variety of locations, including those added by expansion mods, without necessarily requiring every map to be configured individually.
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff0000][size=4]Dead Air[/size][/color] [color=#ff7700][u]Elimination:[/u][/color][/font][/b][b][i][color=#c27ba0][font=Comic Sans MS] Immersive Music[/font][/color][/i][/b] tackles one of the common problems in dynamic music systems:[color=#ff0000][font=Comic Sans MS][b] Dead air[/b][/font][/color] — those unwanted silent gaps when a track ends and no new music begins. By detecting track endings and automatically requesting the next suitable track, the system keeps the soundtrack flowing naturally while [color=#3c78d8][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Smart Shuffle[/b][/font][/size][/color] helps prevent immediate repetition.
[b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#ffff00]My goal[/color]:[/i][/font][/size][/b] to let the music adapt to the world you are exploring, rather than forcing every location to rely on a manually defined list of map names.

[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🔀 [b][color=#3c78d8]Smart Shuffle — Intelligent Track Shuffling![/color][/b][/font][/size]
No more finishing a song only to hear the exact same track play again immediately!
[b][i][color=#3c78d8][font=Comic Sans MS]Smart Shuffle[/font][/color][/i][/b] selects music from the appropriate group while minimizing immediate repetition of the track you just heard. It also maintains playback history, allowing you to navigate to previous or next tracks when supported.
As a result, even familiar locations can offer a fresher listening experience with every [b][color=#3c78d8][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]new exploration.[/font][/size][/color][/b]

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]🎶 Music HUD — A Customizable Music Interface![/b][/font][/size][/color]
See what's playing with the [b][color=#ff7700][font=Comic Sans MS]Music HUD[/font][/color],[/b] designed specifically for [b][i][color=#d5a6bd][font=Comic Sans MS]Immersive Music![/font][/color][/i][/b]
The HUD includes:
[list]
[*]Track notifications when a new song starts playing.[/*]
[*]A rotating vinyl record for a distinctive visual touch.[/*]
[*]Previous and Next controls to navigate between tracks when supported.[/*]
[*]An option to keep the HUD always visible or let it hide automatically after a short period.[/*]
[*]A configurable HUD toggle key through [b][color=#ff7700]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/color][color=#ffffff].[/color][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53735/53735-1792908631-2127427462.png[/img][/*]
[/list]Choose from [b][color=#ff7700][font=Comic Sans MS]4 built-in HUD themes[/font][/color][/b], or expand your customization options with compatible SMAPI content packs. The system supports custom color schemes, decorative styles, and optional PNG overlays.
I've also uploaded a [b][color=#ff7700][font=Comic Sans MS]HUD Custom Theme Pack Guide For Modder[/font][/color][/b] to this page to help anyone interested in creating their own HUD themes!
[quote][center][color=#e06666][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]🚀 IM-Ray Technology — Custom Jukebox Track[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote]Want to listen to your own favorite music while playing [b][color=#ff7700][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley?[/font][/color][/b]
[b][color=#e06666][font=Comic Sans MS][i]IM-Ray Technology[/i][/font][/color][/b] expands the customization possibilities of [b][i][color=#c27ba0][font=Comic Sans MS]Immersive Music[/font][/color][/i][/b], allowing you to add your own
[code].ogg[/code]music files to the in-game Jukebox.
Getting started is simple:
[list=1]
[*]Add your
[code].ogg[/code]files to the
[code]assets/IMRAY[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and let Immersive Music scan and register valid audio files.[/*]
[*]Select the tracks you want to play through the in-game Jukebox.[/*]
[/list]You can also use the SMAPI console command
[code]imray_rescan[/code]to scan the folder again for custom music files.
Most importantly, [b][color=#e06666][font=Comic Sans MS]IM-Ray operates independently of the automatic custom music system.[/font][/color][/b] You can disable [color=#ff7700]Enable Custom Music[/color] to return to vanilla music behavior while keeping[font=Comic Sans MS] [b][i][color=#e06666]IM-Ray[/color][/i][/b][/font] available, as long as [b][i][color=#e06666][font=Comic Sans MS]IM-Ray[/font][/color][/i][/b] itself remains enabled.
If [color=#e06666][font=Comic Sans MS][b]IM-Ray[/b][/font][/color] proves stable and reliable, it could become a [b][color=#ff7700]major milestone[/color][/b] and a stepping stone toward transforming [b][i][color=#c27ba0][font=Comic Sans MS]Immersive Music[/font][/color][/i][/b] into a more extensible[color=#ff7700] [b]music framework[/b][/color] in the future!
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53735/53735-1792909176-2061613027.png[/img]
[heading][quote][center][font=Comic Sans MS]🎧 [color=#cccccc]A FAMILIAR WORLD, A DIFFERENT EXPERIENCE[/color][/font][/center]
[/quote][/heading]
[color=#c27ba0][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Immersive Music[/b][/font][/color] was created for players who love [b][color=#ff7700][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley[/font][/color][/b] and want to refresh its soundtrack while preserving the familiar charm of the original game.
Enjoy peaceful mornings on the farm, relaxing rainy days, adventures in new lands, and quiet nights beneath the stars.
[b][color=#ff7700]Don't just change what you hear. Change the way you experience the world of [font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley[/font].[/color][/b]
Thank you for taking the time to explore [b][color=#c27ba0][font=Comic Sans MS]Immersive Music — Complete Edition.[/font][/color][/b] Wishing you many relaxing and memorable adventures in the valley!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53735/53735-1792909157-338093377.jpg[/img]
[quote][center][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i][color=#b6b6b6]🔮 [/color][color=#ffff00]FUTURE PLANS [/color][/i][/b][/font][/size][/center]
[/quote]There are still many exciting things to explore with [b][color=#c27ba0][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Immersive Music — Complete Edition![/i][/font][/color][/b] 🌱
I hope to continue expanding the music system, introducing new experiences, and providing more options so players can create a [b][color=#ff7700][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley[/font][/color][/b] world that reflects their own personal style.

[heading]💡 [color=#ffe599]Planned Updates[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]❤️ [b][color=#e06666]Low Health Music:[/color][/b] Continue refining and expanding the low-health music system to make dangerous situations feel more tense, immersive, and impactful.[/*]
[*]🏠 [b][color=#e69138]Interior Music:[/color][/b] Introduce more dedicated music groups for indoor environments, giving different interiors a more distinctive atmosphere.[/*]
[*]🛍️ [b][color=#6d9eeb]Pierre’s General Store & JojaMart:[/color][/b] Add unique music themes for[color=#ffffff] Pierre’s General Store and JojaMart[/color], giving each location its own musical identity.[/*]
[*]🏛️ [b][color=#999999]Community Center:[/color][/b] Introduce a dedicated music theme for the [color=#ffffff]Community Center[/color], creating a warm, nostalgic atmosphere that complements its restoration journey.[/*]
[/list][size=4]💚[/size] [b][color=#93c47d][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]These are just plans for the future.[/font][/size][/color][/b]
Features and music packs are subject to change based on development progress, timing, and community feedback. Thank you to everyone who has shown interest in, experienced, and supported[b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS] [color=#c27ba0]Immersive Music[/color][/font][/size][/b] throughout this journey!
— HoangTuDaa18

[*]Place the mod folder inside your game's Mods directory:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]

[/list][b]Please make sure to install only one version of Immersive Music at a time.[/b]
